title: Data export — plans.json
description: « Plans » of « Exporter mes données » (planastro-export-<AAAA-MM-JJ>.zip, formatVersion 1). `plans`: every plan, each the planner's plan — the shape of plan-archive.schema.json's `plan` (`id`, `date`, `name`, `items`, and the planner's other fields) — with `resourceId`, the v1 resource's own id, when the plan has one, and `status` in the v1 vocabulary. `nights` (additive, absent from the files written before it): the planner's nights, each as the planner document keeps it (`id`, `date`, `location`, …) — the night a plan names by its `nightId`; the phone writes an empty list (its nights are its plans' dates and places). `projects`: the multi-night plans, as project.schema.json's `resource`. Identifiers are kept as they are: the import of a private portal finds a record by its identifier.
